rule: Only same-branch M2_mem/Z_mem fixes lambda_mem; separate fitted Z and M2 values are not meaningful without normalization.
The 38.6 um alpha=1 threshold is an anchor-smoke gate, not a full alpha(lambda) bound curve.
If M2_mem=0, local GR requires exact Q_eff=0; do not call the massless branch screened.
Negative M2_mem is an instability branch and cannot be used for local GR recovery.
